name: HYDRA-UMC-MESHES
notes: The shared 3D meshes (STL and GLB) of the HYDRA-UMC desktop and web apps, published once as a release package instead of being copied into each repository. The release carries one archive with every distinct mesh stored once and a manifest with the SHA-256 of the archive and of each file; HYDRA-UMC-STUDIO and HYDRA-UMC-SUITE download it on demand and check every file against the manifest before writing anything. The repository holds only the manifest and its checksums; the check in CI confirms that the manifest and the checksums agree.
